abilities.name: Permanent Cloak
abilities.description: Gain Stealth when out of combat for 3 seconds. Taking damage, attacking, using Abilities, or channeling ends Stealth. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.; 3; trait

fields.notes: Stealth and Invisibility can be gained while mounted.

abilities.name: Singularity Spike
abilities.description: Flings a Singularity Spike that sticks to the first enemy hit. Deals 240 damage after 1 second and Slows the enemy by 40% for 3 seconds.

fields.notes: Singularity Spike grants vision in 2.7 radius around the target, until it explodes. Singularity Spike is instantly removed, preventing any associated effects from triggering, if the target becomes Invulnerable, or enters Stasis.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.description: Teleport to the target location. Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

abilities.name: Might Of The Nerazim
abilities.description: Activate to cast an untalented version of Zeratul's most recently used Basic Ability, dealing 50% less damage. Passive After using an Ability, Zeratul's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 30% more damage.; 20; 30; heroic

fields.notes: Does not interact with Vorpal Blade in any way. Has all the same properties as the untalented Basic Ability, except its base damage is set to half of the original. Might of the Nerazim does not affect Talented versions of the Ability that involve reactivating the Ability. Attack Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Zeratul's Basic Attack damage.

abilities.name: Void Prison
abilities.description: Slows time in an area to a near standstill, placing allies and enemies in Time Stop for 5 seconds. Zeratul is not affected.; 100 / 1.5; 80; heroic

fields.notes: Void Prison can be ended prematurely by reactivating the Ability. Target units that walk into the AoE after the Ability has been cast are also affected.

abilities.name: Vorpal Blade
abilities.description: Activate to teleport to Zeratul's last non-Structure Basic Attack target within 3 seconds. The target is Revealed during these 3 seconds.; 15; :False

fields.notes: When teleporting with Vorpal Blade, Zeratul retains the direction he is facing and is placed right next to the target in a position where the target is right in front of him. The mark is consumed immediately upon cast, but the target will still be revealed for its full duration (3 seconds after the last AA).

talents.name: Greater Cleave
talents.description: Increases the radius of Cleave by 33%.
_raw_fields: Increases the radius of Cleave by 33%.

talents.name: Shadow Hunter
talents.description: quest Gather Regeneration Globes to lower the Mana cost of Blink by 3. Upon gathering 15 Regeneration Globes, Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Blink by 1.5 seconds.
_raw_fields: quest Gather Regeneration Globes to lower the Mana cost of Blink by 3. Upon gathering 15 Regeneration Globes, Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Blink by 1.5 seconds.

talents.name: Move Unseen
talents.description: Reduce the cooldown of Permanent Cloak by 1 second. Gain 30% Movement Speed while Stealthed.
_raw_fields: Reduce the cooldown of Permanent Cloak by 1 second. Gain 30% Movement Speed while Stealthed.

talents.name: Rending Cleave
talents.description: Cleave deals an additional 40% damage over 3 seconds.

fields.notes: Rending Cleave benefits from all of Zeratul's talents affecting Cleave. Rending Cleave has independent base damage values, causing the given percentage to stack multiplicatively with offensive damage modifiers.

_raw_fields: Cleave deals an additional 40% damage over 3 seconds.

talents.name: Psionic Strength
talents.description: Dealing damage to enemy Heroes increases all damage dealt by 6% for 3 seconds, stacking up to 30%.

fields.notes: Psionic Strength gains a stack after an enemy Hero has been damaged and therefore only affects subsequent instances of damage. Stacks additively with itself and other damage modifiers affecting Zeratul's damage output.

_raw_fields: Dealing damage to enemy Heroes increases all damage dealt by 6% for 3 seconds, stacking up to 30%.

talents.name: Darkness Descends
talents.description: cooldown 30 Activate to gain 40% bonus Attack Speed for 5 seconds. passive Gain 20% Attack Speed.

fields.notes: Active and passive bonuses stack additively with each other as well as other effects affecting Zeratul's Attack Speed.

_raw_fields: cooldown 30 Activate to gain 40% bonus Attack Speed for 5 seconds. passive Gain 20% Attack Speed.

talents.name: Wormhole
talents.description: After 1.25 seconds, reactivate Blink to return to the point where it was cast from, within 4 seconds.
_raw_fields: After 1.25 seconds, reactivate Blink to return to the point where it was cast from, within 4 seconds.

talents.name: Seeker in the Dark
talents.description: Singularity Spike takes 50% longer to explode. It can be reactivated to teleport to the target, granting 30% increased Move Speed for 3 seconds.

talents.name: Warp Skirmisher
talents.description: Vorpal Blade gains a 2nd charge. Teleporting with Vorpal Blade or entering Permanent Cloak causes Zeratul's next Basic Attack to deal 50% increased damage.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Zeratul's Basic Attack damage.

talents.name: Spell Shield
talents.description: Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%. Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other positive Spell Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

talents.description: If Cleave hits more than one enemy Hero, it deals 40% increased damage and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

talents.name: Sentenced to Death
talents.description: Deal 25% increased damage to enemies while they are marked or Slowed by Singularity Spike.

fields.notes: Removing the Slow effect from the target after Singularity Spike has exploded also removes the damage bonus. Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Zeratul's damage output.
